name: copyappearance-simple
description: IXT-SUITES batch 4: copyAppearance (simple) flag — the single-item inspector's 'Copy appearance' / 'Paste appearance' buttons (ItemBulkActions) transfer a look-only prop subset (e.g. upholstery colour) between two same-category items, on in both Simple and Pro.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: assert-simple-on
steps.failMessage: copyAppearance should be on in Simple (simple tier, default true)
